editorial.meta_description: The Oracle 1Z0-1104-23 exam is retired. Review verified details and transition your preparation plan to the 1Z0-1104-24 successor.
editorial.overview: Certified by Oracle, the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2023 Security Professional exam covered security architecture, identity management, network security, data protection, security operations, threat management, and compliance across cloud environments. This exam is retired as of 2024-08-31 and has been replaced by 1Z0-1104-24 as the official successor, giving candidates a total of 60 questions to complete during the evaluation.
editorial.who_should_take: Cloud security professionals and infrastructure engineers with practical experience securing enterprise workloads. Candidates must shift their focus to the 1Z0-1104-24 exam to validate current Oracle Cloud Infrastructure security expertise.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Since this exam is retired, do not attempt to register for it or purchase it for $245.00 USD. Prepare exclusively for the successor 1Z0-1104-24 instead. Core OCI security principles, encryption standards, and shared security models transfer directly, but you must study updated documentation for current service configurations.

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain covers vital security architecture principles along with structural design patterns that are required for building secure enterprise cloud environments across modern infrastructure systems and networks.

This section focuses heavily on identity management systems, user account provisioning, authentication policies, and least-privilege access controls designed to secure cloud tenant resources effectively across all user groups.

All candidates must review virtual networking configurations, routing gateways, load balancing mechanisms, and network traffic protection features meant to defend against external threats and intrusions within the cloud.

This domain explores thorough data classification strategies, key management practices, and strict encryption standards implemented for protecting sensitive data both at rest and in transit across storage services.

Operational security tracking and active monitoring are examined through continuous monitoring tools, detailed audit logs, and systematic observation practices established for monitoring cloud resource activities and configuration changes over time.

This extensive thematic study area covers vulnerability detection methodologies, thorough threat analysis techniques, and recurring resource configuration checks designed to identify weaknesses across deployed cloud environments and virtual assets.

Governance policies and regulatory compliance frameworks are evaluated carefully throughout this domain to ensure proper organizational adherence to established security standards and internal security zone configuration mandates across tenant subscriptions.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Because this exam is retired and no longer administered, candidates cannot schedule a test session for it. Review the exam policies for the successor 1Z0-1104-24 to prepare for testing logistics, scoring, and question formats.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The retired exam format consisted of exactly 60 multiple choice and multiple select questions delivered in a linear format during the allotted testing time provided to every candidate.
The passing score required to pass this specific certification exam was set at a fixed threshold of 65 percent of the total available points across the evaluation.
Test takers were given a total duration of 90 minutes to complete all questions presented on the examination before the allowed testing time officially expired.

faq.question_title: What exam replaces this retired certification?
faq.answer_text: The verified official successor is 1Z0-1104-24, which serves as the direct replacement path for candidates seeking to validate their updated security credentials and cloud knowledge.

methodology.summary: This index page compiles official Oracle documentation, retirement schedules, and domain weights to provide verified tracking information for all users reviewing historical exams.
